why: A delivers the requested look: light birch and ash, cream textiles, a bamboo pendant, and real green from the cushions, palm and rug edge. Its weak points are an undersized coffee table, a dining table tight for six, and a dark walnut sideboard. B is better sized, but its cognac leather, mid-tone woods, glam white-and-gold sideboard, grey tones and near-total lack of green drift away from the warm, light Nordic brief.
